figures.caption: Fig. 1: A comparison between our model and previous work. For the attribution explanations, the latent embeddings of explanations are learned from the ECG dataset. Our explanations are within the original distribution, whereas the reference model’s explanations are not. For the counterfactual explanations, our framework represents more robust results.

Fig. 2: The overall architecture of TimeX++, a unified framework for attribution and counterfactual explanations supported by Information Bottleneck. TimeXa++ and TimeXcf++ have similar components and loss functions but different implementations.
